title: Neutral versus ionized gas kinematics at z ≃ 2.6: the AGN-host starburst galaxy PKS 0529-549
question: Do neutral ([C I]) and ionized ([O III]) gas trace the same kinematics in PKS 0529-549 at z~2.6, and is the [C I] disc dynamically relaxed and baryon-dominated?

data.sensitivity: continuum 0.055 mJy/beam; [C I] 0.55 mJy/beam per 50 km/s channel

what.value: Stellar mass and H-band luminosity from Spitzer SED fit

evidence.quote: For PKS 0529-549, they give $L_{\rm H} \simeq 4 \times 10^{11}$ L$_{\odot}$ and $M_{\star} \simeq 3 \times 10^{11}$ M$_{\odot}$.
estimate $2.4\times10^{9}$ M$_{\odot}$ for a fiducial electron density of 500 cm$^{-3}$

what.value: Local baryonic Tully-Fisher relation from SPARC

evidence.quote: lies on the local baryonic TF relation from the SPARC sample

recipe.method: CASA clean, natural weighting, 50 km/s channels, image-plane continuum subtraction
Boolean-masked moment 0 and intensity-weighted moment 1 in GIPSY
GALMOD trial-and-error for initial estimates and geometry, then 3DBarolo chi2 fit of Vrot and sigma in a single ring
M_R = eps R Vrot^2/G with eps=1; baryonic mass from stellar (literature) + molecular (from [C I] flux) + WIM
assumptions: [C/H2] abundance of M82; factor of 2 uncertainty

recipe.method: Place Vrot and Mbar on local SPARC BTFR

evidence.quote: the total baryonic mass of PKS 0529-549 is $M_{\rm bar} = (3.4\pm2.0) \times 10^{11}$ $M_{\odot}$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel ranges for continuum subtraction
3DBarolo settings (initial estimates, ring geometry, normalization, fit options)
GALMOD fixed centre, PA, Vsys values and iteration details
CASA version and clean parameters (cell, image size, threshold)
Mol mass conversion details (Man et al. in prep.)
missing_for_reproduction: Companion papers in prep. for flux and Mmol
score_reason: Public ALMA data and clear workflow, but modelling and masking details incomplete and some inputs from in-prep papers.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric Vrot/sigma results; recipe moderately complete.
